messages:
maria: Hey team, incoming model bundle from partner — weights + tokenizer + manifest uploaded to s3://redwood-acq/consignments/zeno-3b/2026-03-18/. Can we do quick provenance + onboarding priority triage?

maria: Manifest lists weights files: zeno-3b-0000.bin .. zeno-3b-0007.bin, tokenizer.json, vocab.bpe, and manifest.json.sha256. KMS key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111:alias/consignment-ingest.

maria: checksum snippet from partner: ```
zeno-3b-0000.bin  d2f9c3a5d1e3...
tokenizer.json     9f8b7c3a2a1b...
manifest.json.sha256  abc123...
```

derek: got it. tagging this as low-latency priority? what's the intended evaluation set?

maria: product asked for benchmark on convo-turn-level quality + instruction-following. Sophie to own eval suites. Derek to run quantization sweep (4-bit/8-bit) in sandbox and smoke perf.

ajay: I see the S3 path but need a copy job to our ingest bucket + KMS decrypt permissions for infra-runner role. @maria can you confirm transport checksum matches on our side before we register?

maria: Affirmative — I'm running a local verify now. If mismatch, we'll reject and ask partner to re-upload with signed manifest.

ingest-bot: [AUTO] copy started -> s3://ingest.redwood/models/zeno-3b/2187654321/ (initiated by maria)

maria: verify output: ```
sha256sum -c manifest.json.sha256
zeno-3b-0000.bin: OK
zeno-3b-0001.bin: OK
tokenizer.json: OK
``` All checksums match.

derek: next: registry entry. I'll create a provisional model record with provenance metadata and origin tags, mark status=\"quarantine\" until quant+eval pass. Need commit hash for tokenizer preprocessing script — can you attach that to the manifest, @maria?

maria: added field \"tokenizer_preproc_git\": https://git.redwood.ai/rlm/tokenizer-tools/commit/ab4e3f. Updated manifest on S3 (manifest.json.v2) and re-signed.

ajay: infra has permissions to decrypt KMS key, copying finished. I'll schedule a dedicated sandbox node (A100-40G) for derek's quant sweep. ETA 30m.

sophie: I'll queue the conv-turn evals and a small adversarial prompt set. Can you include a baseline run on current prod-replicate model for regression comparison? I want relative ROUGE/BERTSCORE + latency per token.

derek: plan for quant sweep: 8-bit per-channel -> 4-bit GPTQ and PTQ variants. Quick smoke for coherence + generation divergence threshold. If regression >2% on eval set we'll block rollout. Will post results here.

maria: one more — add the custody ledger entry and store manifest.signed in our artifact ledger (ledger://acq/zeno-3b/2187654321). I uploaded the signed manifest and S3-version id to the ticket.

ingest-bot: [AUTO] registry record created: model_id=zeno-3b:trial-2026-03-18, status=quarantine, provenance=[s3://redwood-acq/consignments/zeno-3b/2026-03-18/, ledger://acq/zeno-3b/2187654321]

sophie: thanks — once quant results in, I'll run regression diffs and flag quality alerts if needed. If all green, we can move to canary rollout in dedicated for throughput tests. :thumbsup:

maria: perfect. tagging follow-ups: @derek (quant run), @sophie (evals), @ajay (sandbox infra). I'll close the intake ticket after we hit green.
